=== FILE test/docs/readme-commands.test.ts === ⏎ import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from "vitest"; ⏎ import { readFileSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs"; ⏎ import { tmpdir } from "node:os"; ⏎ import path from "node:path"; ⏎ import { run } from "../../src/cli/main.js"; ⏎ import { ROOT } from "../units/_unit.js"; ⏎ interface CommandBlock { ⏎ command: string; ⏎ expectedExit: number; ⏎ isLive: boolean; ⏎ } ⏎ function extractShellBlocks(filePath: string): CommandBlock[] { ⏎ const content = readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, filePath), "utf8"); ⏎ const blocks: CommandBlock[] = []; ⏎ const lines = content.split("
"); ⏎ let inShellBlock = false; ⏎ let currentBlock: string[] = []; ⏎ for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { ⏎ const line = lines[i]; ⏎ if (line === undefined) continue; ⏎ if (line.trim().startsWith("```sh") || line.trim().startsWith("```shell")) { ⏎ inShellBlock = true; ⏎ currentBlock = []; ⏎ } else if (line.trim() === "```" && inShellBlock) { ⏎ inShellBlock = false; ⏎ const blockText = currentBlock.join("
"); ⏎ const commandLines = blockText.split("
").filter((l) => l.trim() && !l.trim().startsWith("#")); ⏎ for (const cmdLine of commandLines) { ⏎ if (cmdLine.includes("flop-harness")) { ⏎ const isLive = blockText.includes("# live"); ⏎ const exitMatch = /# exit (\d+)/.exec(blockText); ⏎ const exitStr = exitMatch?.[1]; ⏎ const expectedExit = exitStr !== undefined ? parseInt(exitStr, 10) : 0; ⏎ blocks.push({ command: cmdLine.trim(), expectedExit, isLive }); ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } else if (inShellBlock) { ⏎ currentBlock.push(line); ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ return blocks; ⏎ } ⏎ describe("README and docs shell commands", () => { ⏎ let scratchHome: string; ⏎ beforeEach(() => { ⏎ scratchHome = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "flop-harness-test-")); ⏎ }); ⏎ afterEach(() => { ⏎ rmSync(scratchHome, { recursive: true, force: true }); ⏎ }); ⏎ const files = ["README.md", "docs/SKILL.md"]; ⏎ for (const file of files) { ⏎ describe(file, () => { ⏎ const blocks = extractShellBlocks(file); ⏎ for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) { ⏎ const block = blocks[i]; ⏎ if (block === undefined) continue; ⏎ it(`command ${i + 1}: ${block.command.slice(0, 60)}`, async () => { ⏎ if (block.isLive) { ⏎ return; ⏎ } ⏎ const args = block.command.split(/\s+/).filter((a) => a); ⏎ const oldHome = process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_HOME; ⏎ const oldFixture = process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_FIXTURE; ⏎ try { ⏎ process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_HOME = scratchHome; ⏎ process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_FIXTURE = "1"; ⏎ const exitCode = await run(args); ⏎ expect(exitCode).toBe(block.expectedExit); ⏎ } finally { ⏎ if (oldHome !== undefined) process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_HOME = oldHome; ⏎ else delete process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_HOME; ⏎ if (oldFixture !== undefined) process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_FIXTURE = oldFixture; ⏎ else delete process.env.FLOP_HARNESS_FIXTURE; ⏎ } ⏎ }); ⏎ } ⏎ }); ⏎ } ⏎ });
